$Comment: A parts crate on A2's conveyor belts (DESIGN.md 5.3 H5). Inert: no attack, takes no damage, ignores players and NPCs. The belt volumes carry it (KnockbackScale 1: Role.processAddVelocityInstruction multiplies every pushed velocity by it, so 0 kept it still); its Hard HitboxCollision comes from the prefab it is pasted from (Server/Prefabs/Heartworks/Parts_Crate/).

MotionControllerList.$Comment: Gravity makes the crate settle on the belt. No instruction issues a moving BodyMotion; the speed values only satisfy the validator.

Instructions.$Comment: Stand still and do nothing: the belt does the moving.
